statusBar.title: Status Bar

diagnosticInfo.title: Diagnostic Info
diagnosticInfo.desc: Show technical details for troubleshooting and diagnostics.

keyboardLeds.title: Keyboard LEDs
keyboardLeds.desc: Show the remote system's keyboard LED indicators.

hideCursor.title: Hide Cursor
hideCursor.desc: Hide the cursor while controlling the remote system.

cursorStyle.title: Cursor style
cursorStyle.desc: Choose the appearance of the cursor.

scrollThrottling.title: Scrolling Speed
scrollThrottling.desc: Reduce scrolling speed on the remote system.

jiggler.title: Mouse Jiggler
jiggler.desc: Simulate small mouse movements at regular intervals to keep the system awake.

inputMode.title: Mouse Mode
inputMode.desc: Choose how the mouse behaves on the remote system.

absolute.title: Absolute
absolute.tip: Absolute mode maps your mouse position directly to the remote screen, making it easier to control in most situations.

relative.title: Relative
relative.tip: Relative mode behaves like a traditional PC mouse and is useful for specific applications.

toast.noMouseDevice: Mouse control is no longer available because no mouse device is enabled.
toast.changedToRelative: Mouse Mode was automatically changed to Relative Mouse.
toast.changedToAbsolute: Mouse Mode was automatically changed to Absolute Mouse.

page.title: Keyboard
page.description: Configure keyboard settings for your device

keyboardLayout.title: Keyboard Layout
keyboardLayout.desc: Select the keyboard layout of the remote operating system
tip: The virtual keyboard, text paste, and shortcut keys send individual keystrokes to the remote device.
The keyboard layout determines how these keystrokes are interpreted.
Make sure the selected layout matches the keyboard settings of the remote operating system.
Note: Text paste relies on direct keystroke input. Some non-Latin characters (such as Chinese, Japanese, or Korean) may not be supported due to input method limitations.

ledSync.title: LED state synchronization
ledSync.desc: Synchronize the LED state of the keyboard with the target device

showPressedKeys.title: Show Pressed Keys
showPressedKeys.desc: Display currently pressed keys in the status bar

modifierKeyRelease.title: Modifier Key Release
modifierKeyRelease.desc: Control how modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Cmd) are released after a key combination

cameraEmulation.title: Camera Emulation
cameraEmulation.desc: Enable remote apps to use local camera

streamQuality.title: Stream Quality
streamQuality.desc: Adjust the quality of the video stream

enhancement.title: Video Color
enhancement.desc: Adjust color settings to make the video output more vibrant and colorful

edid.title: EDID
edid.desc: Configure EDID settings for display compatibility

custom.title: Custom EDID
custom.desc: EDID determines video mode compatibility.  Default settings work in most cases, but some UEFI/BIOS configurations may require adjustments.
custom.placeholder: Paste an EDID hex string (even length, 0–9 and A–F). Spaces are allowed and will be removed automatically.

streamQuality.title: Stream quality
streamQuality.desc: Adjust the quality of the audio stream

playback.title: Playback
playback.desc: Stream remote audio to this device

microphoneEmulation.title: Microphone emulation
microphoneEmulation.desc: Enable remote apps to access local microphone

orientation.title: Display Orientation
orientation.desc: Set the orientation of the display

displayBrightness.title: Display Brightness
displayBrightness.desc: Set the brightness of the display

dimAfter.title: Dim Display After
dimAfter.desc: Set the delay before the display dims

turnOffAfter.title: Turn off Display After
turnOffAfter.desc: Set the period of inactivity before the display automatically turns off.
turnOffAfter.tip: The display will wake up when the screen is touched.

usb.title: USB Devices
usb.desc: Configure USB device emulation for the remote computer

classes.title: Devices
classes.desc: Choose which USB devices to emulate on the target computer

keyboardRelativeMouse.title: Keyboard & Relative Mouse
keyboardRelativeMouse.desc: Emulates a USB keyboard and relative mouse. Recommended for BIOS, GRUB, KVM switches, games, and legacy systems.

absoluteMouse.title: Absolute Mouse (Pointer)
absoluteMouse.desc: Emulates an absolute-position USB pointer for direct cursor alignment with the target screen.

virtualStorage.title: Virtual Storage
virtualStorage.desc: Enables virtual storage devices such as Virtual Media and Virtual USB Drive.

usbMicrophone.title: USB Microphone
usbMicrophone.desc: Emulates a USB microphone input device on the target computer.

virtualUsbDrive.title: Virtual USB Drive
virtualUsbDrive.desc: Present a writable USB drive for file transfer
virtualUsbDrive.warning: This drive uses FAT32. Reformatting it may prevent ArkKVM from mounting it again.

identifiers.title: Device Identifiers
identifiers.desc: Configure the USB device information shown to the target computer

macAddress.title: MAC Address
macAddress.desc: Hardware identifier of the network interface

httpProxy.title: HTTP Proxy
httpProxy.desc: Proxy server for outgoing HTTP and HTTPS requests. Leave blank to connect directly.

domain.title: Domain
domain.desc: Set the DNS search domain for this device.

mdns.title: mDNS
mdns.desc: Control how this device is discovered on the local network

timeSynchronization.title: Time synchronization
timeSynchronization.desc: Configure how the device synchronizes system time

vlan.title: VLAN (802.1Q)
vlan.desc: Connect ArkKVM to tagged VLAN networks using IEEE 802.1Q.

enableWarning.title: Enable VLAN?
enableWarning.line1: Enabling VLAN mode replaces the untagged network interface with tagged VLAN interfaces.
enableWarning.line2: Incorrect settings may make the device unreachable.

primaryVlan.title: Primary VLAN
primaryVlan.desc: Used for outbound system traffic and internet-connected services.

vlanId.title: VLAN ID
vlanId.desc: Enter a VLAN ID between 1 and 4094. The connected switch port must allow this tagged VLAN.

secondaryVlan.title: Secondary VLAN
secondaryVlan.desc: Provides additional local access to ArkKVM, but does not carry outbound system traffic.
secondaryVlan.idDesc: Secondary VLAN must use a different VLAN ID from the Primary VLAN.

ipv4Mode.title: IPv4 Mode
ipv4Mode.desc: Configure how the device obtains an IPv4 address

ipv6Mode.title: IPv6 Mode
ipv6Mode.desc: Configure how the device obtains an IPv6 address

dhcpLease.title: DHCP Lease Information
dhcpLease.renewContent: This will request a new IP address from your DHCP server. Your device may temporarily lose network connectivity during this process.

switchToDhcp.title: Switch to DHCP?
switchToDhcp.desc: Click "Save Settings" to apply this change and automatically get network information.

ipv4Pending.title: IPv4 Information
ipv4Pending.desc: Save settings to apply this configuration and obtain IPv4 network information.

ipv6Pending.title: IPv6 Information
ipv6Pending.desc: Save settings to apply this configuration and obtain IPv6 network information.

webTerminal.title: Web Terminal
webTerminal.desc: Enable shell access via the web interface

loopbackOnly.title: Loopback-Only Mode
loopbackOnly.desc: Restrict web interface access to localhost only (127.0.0.1)

sshAccess.title: SSH Access
sshAccess.desc: Allow SSH access with key-based authentication
sshAccess.keyPlaceholder: Paste your SSH public key here...

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting Mode
troubleshooting.desc: Diagnostic tools and additional controls for troubleshooting and development purposes

resetConfig.title: Reset Configuration
resetConfig.desc: Reset most settings to their default values. You will be signed out.

local.title: Local
local.desc: Manage local access settings for the device

httpsMode.title: HTTPS Mode
httpsMode.desc: Choose how secure connections are handled

tlsCertificate.title: TLS Certificate
tlsCertificate.desc: Paste your TLS certificate  below. Include the full chain, such as the leaf, intermediate, and root certificates.
tlsCertificate.keyDescription: The private key must match the uploaded certificate. For security reasons, it won’t be displayed after applying.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.desc: Update the password for local access to this device
changePassword.formDesc: Enter your current password and choose a new password.
changePassword.successDesc: Your local password has been updated.Use the new password for future access.
changePassword.errorGeneral: An error occurred while changing the password

remote.title: Remote
remote.desc: Manage remote access settings for the device

cloudProvider.title: Cloud Provider
cloudProvider.desc: Choose the cloud service used for remote access

cloudSecurity.title: Cloud Security
cloudSecurity.feature1: End-to-end encryption via WebRTC (DTLS and SRTP)
cloudSecurity.openSourceText: All cloud components are open-source and available on
cloudSecurity.learnMoreButton: Learn more about our cloud security

localAuth.title: Set Local Password
localAuth.desc: Set a password to prevent unauthorized access to your device.
localAuth.successDesc: A local password has been set. Your device is now protected against unauthorized local access.
localAuth.errorGeneral: An error occurred while setting the password

removePassword.title: Remove Local Password
removePassword.desc: Enter your current password to disable local device protection.
removePassword.successDesc: The local password has been removed. Local access to this device is no longer protected.
removePassword.errorGeneral: An error occurred while removing the password

privateNetwork.title: Private Network
privateNetwork.desc: Choose and enable private network services for remote access

tailscale.title: Tailscale
tailscale.desc: Connect ArkKVM to your Tailscale network
